Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made an error in Step 1 by misinterpreting the information from the search results. While the search results from DuckDuckGo clearly indicated that Francisco Jose Hernandez participated in the Bay of Pigs Invasion in April 1961, WebSurfer incorrectly identified the year as 1960 in subsequent steps. This initial misinterpretation of the year propagated throughout the conversation and led to unnecessary repeated searches and instructions from the Planner to verify the year, despite the correct year (1961) being clearly stated in multiple sources, including the CANF biography and the Wikipedia page. This caused confusion and unnecessary redundancy in the workflow.
